{HoldPattern[solveFresnelN[wAir_, wMed_, wSub_, thickness_, unknowns_]] :> Module[{sol = {}, i, equ = {}, equE, equH, nM, equTop, equBot, getH, nloop = 0, B, M}, nM = Length[wMed]; getH[wav_] := Cross[Key[k][wav], Key[EE][wav]]/(Key[ω][wav]*μ0); equTop = {Total[Key[EE] /@ wAir][[1 ;; 2]] == Total[Key[EE] /@ wMed[[1]]][[1 ;; 2]], Total[getH /@ wAir][[1 ;; 2]] == Total[getH /@ wMed[[1]]][[1 ;; 2]]}; AppendTo[equ, equTop]; For[i = 1, i < nM, i++, equE = Total[(Exp[I*(#1[k] . {0, 0, 1}*thickness[[i]])]*Key[EE][#1] & ) /@ wMed[[i]]][[1 ;; 2]] == Total[Key[EE] /@ wMed[[i + 1]]][[1 ;; 2]]; equH = Total[(Exp[I*(#1[k] . {0, 0, 1}*thickness[[i]])]*getH[#1] & ) /@ wMed[[i]]][[1 ;; 2]] == Total[getH /@ wMed[[i + 1]]][[1 ;; 2]]; AppendTo[equ, {equE, equH}]]; equBot = {Total[(Exp[I*(#1[k] . {0, 0, 1}*thickness[[nM]])]*Key[EE][#1] & ) /@ wMed[[nM]]][[1 ;; 2]] == Total[Key[EE] /@ wSub][[1 ;; 2]], Total[(Exp[I*(#1[k] . {0, 0, 1}*thickness[[nM]])]*getH[#1] & ) /@ wMed[[nM]]][[1 ;; 2]] == Total[getH /@ wSub][[1 ;; 2]]}; AppendTo[equ, equBot]; equ = Flatten[equ]; equ = Flatten[Thread /@ equ]; If[debug, Print["k of wMed
", (#1[k] & ) /@ wMed[[nM]]]]; If[debug, Print["Here!!! equ
", MatrixForm[Chop[Simplify[Flatten[Thread /@ equ] /. {Δδ -> 0}]]]]]; If[flagLinearSolve, {B, M} = Normal[CoefficientArrays[equ, unknowns]]; sol = Thread[unknowns -> LinearSolve[M, B]]; , Quiet[If[flagNSolve, sol = NSolve[equ, unknowns], sol = Solve[equ, unknowns]]]; If[Length[sol] == 0, Print["sol is {} in solveFresnelN!"]; sol = Thread[unknowns -> ConstantArray[0., Length[unknowns]]], sol = sol[[1]]]; ]; If[debug, Print["sol
", MatrixForm[Simplify[sol]]]]; wAir = wAir /. sol; wSub = wSub /. sol; wMed = wMed /. sol; ]}
